preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100 and 2 <= m <= 100 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the dimensions n and m of the binary table are between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(table) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in table) for n, m, table in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case's table has n rows and each row has m columns.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in '01' for cell in row) for _, _, table in test_cases for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m, _ in test_cases) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all test cases does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n * m for n, m, k, _ in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operations k is between 0 and nm inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m and 1 <= x3 <= n and 1 <= y3 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations) for n, m, _, operations in results)
postconditions.description: For each operation in a test case, the coordinates (x1, y1), (x2, y2), and (x3, y3) are within the table bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set((x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3))) == 6 for _, _, _, operations in results for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation in a test case involves three distinct cells.

postconditions.expression: all(all((x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3) in [(i, j), (i, j+1), (i+1, j), (i+1, j+1)] for x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 in operations) for n, m, _, operations in results for i in range(n-1) for j in range(m-1))
postconditions.description: Each operation in a test case involves cells that form a 2x2 square.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell == '0' for row in final_table) for _, _, final_table in results)
postconditions.description: After applying all operations in a test case, all cells in the table are '0'.
